Hello,

I am applying for the Graphic Design Intern position at Marketing Growmatics, drawn specifically to your reach across a 2M+ follower digital media platform.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have built over 100 digital and print creatives including marketing collateral, banners, and presentations. Prior to that, my social media campaign for a fashion brand delivered a 15 percent increase in follower engagement through targeted Instagram and Facebook series.

You can review this specific fashion campaign project, which demonstrates my execution of high-visibility social assets, directly on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Since I am based right here in Nagpur and work daily with typography, layout, and visual hierarchy, I am ready to join your on-site team immediately. Would you be open to a brief look at my campaign work this week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
